reviews.t: There size and easy to squeeze the product out.
reviews.x: I liked how easy they are to fill up with my favorite lotions. Using them on my Maui vacation.

The bag is absolute garbage and is basically half the size of what you can take on a plane. The bottles and containers are AMAZING, but the bag is plastic that will rip easy and there is no fabric on it at all. Bought a different bag for travel and used the bottles  Just plan on getting a different bag if you want this for travel
Good purchase. Easy to fill, empty and clean. Did NOT leak.

reviews.t: Really good silicone and leak proof!
reviews.x: Love the silicone bottles can use for my body butters when traveling. The toothbrush covers too!...those are the little weird shapes included in the carry bag. Lip balm silicone holders!!! I’m gonna order some for my daughter!

I used everything & I filled everything abt 75%. The large bottles didn’t leak, but the smaller ones definitely leaked badly. So glad I used Ziploc bags to be safe.  Also, the smaller containers I put different products in each & every one of them leaked. I put a hair finishing oil, eye cream & body oil in the small containers. The large

These bottles are very nice.  Very soft and bendable and very easy to squeeze.  I gave them 4 stars only because they have an "x" slit as the bottle hole and when you squeeze them the liquid squirts out at great pressure no matter how hard you squeeze them and it shoots the liquid out of your hand and all over the place. reviews.t: My new favorite travel bottle set!
reviews.x: I was surprised how leak proof the travel containers are for my face creams.  They come with a seal inside the lid which has proven to be helpful when tossing the containers in my over night bag.  I also love the toothbrush covers and travel bottles!!! I’ve used some to put hand sanitizer in, I carry it with me when I’m at work.  It’s proven to be helpful in the pandemic!
Produce is what I expected. I received additional parts in the kit which I can not figure out how to use. It would seem Instructions should be included. Good product for the price.
Only problem they have is when you squeeze them in ,it stays stuck like that because no air is getting in

reviews.t: Bottles are nice and don't leak, clear bag is flimsy. Use a different pouch for travel
reviews.x: Bottles are secure and don't leak. The tip of each bottle contains a stopper that prevents contents from spilling out. I didn't use the clear bag it came in because it felt rather flimsy and I don't think would hold up over time. The bottles though are definitely worth the price. You can use the smaller containers for face moisturizer/night cream even  medicine.

Handy dandy packing bottles. plus they weird looking tear shaped things are for toothbrush heads. I only took two of the larger bottles on my first trips with these. You should take them in the container they come in because I left one at a hotel. Super easy to fill, no leaks and if you take the time you could put labels on them. I should have. Get some!

I purchased these so my family could carry hand sanitzer with them.  I wanted containers that I could see into so we knew how much we have left.  I really like that these are silicone and you can squeeze, roll, etc. the containers to dispense the contents.  I have one in my purse, while the boys keep theirs in their car.

This TSA approved bag didn't even get to go on vacation. Bag ripped at zipper before I ever left. Was not overpacked and it ripped right at the seam of the zipper. Ordered another bag but used these containers, which I loved. The containers were great. Didn't leak and were approved size

reviews.t: Threw away to fly home - not leak proof
reviews.x: Not leak proof. I had to throw them away to fly home. The entire bag was filled with my hair products. The top comes off from the base which was difficult to reassemble. Without the product I can’t get a refund but I can save someone else from buying them.
the containers are small so they fit perfect in your purse or back pack. they do not leak and they are cute. i fill them with hand sanitizer for my family and they have worked out very conveniently!
Perfect for traveling or overnight stay! Love that it was easy to squeeze out contents and love the little compact holders with lids for my creams and oils
Sent to nurses for hand sanitizer. They love the quality although it is for liquid hand sani. These bottles are perfect for gel hand sani!

reviews.t: Not bad but flow hard to control
reviews.x: The flow is somewhat strong and not easy to direct

We bought this to mix rubbing alcohol and aloe Vera for a makeshift hand sanitizer since it's so hard to find during the pandemic. These functioned perfectly and the extras were a nice touch.  Pros 1. Hasn't leaked yet. 2. Easy to fill, easy to empty, easy to clean. 3. The toothbrush covers are a nice touch.  Neutral 1. Larger than expected. Not a bad thing but definitely not pocket sized. 2. It's a bit difficult to control the flow if the stuff inside is a bit looser. In other words, it works b

reviews.t: Containers are Nice! But the Clear Bag Broke Easily.
reviews.x: So these containers are really easy to clean and put product inside. I even put mouthwash inside the squeezable container and it was fine (I did put it in a ziploc bag just in case though). The only thing is that the clear bag the products came in broke right away, but I didn't really need it.

The size of the bottles were unexpectedly larger than I thought. They're great for a long trip, and the colors make it easy to tell what you have inside without having to label each one. The little lotion holders and toothbrush holders are perfect for flying. I'm very happy with this purchase.

Flew from Florida to Alaska and back. Never leaked, held the perfect amount of product and even fit other items in the clear quart size zipper bag. Bought a similar product and the zipper broke on it before I even used it. The zipper on this one is strong and zips easily. Great product!

I love this product. I had been using rigid bottles for all of my traveling and camping needs. These are so much easier to use, especially with thicker products like my face wash. It was always so difficult to get it out of the rigid containers, but these make my life way easier!

I love these things! I use them for my daughter's diapering creams. Their color coded so I know exactly which ones I'm going for, and I use the small containers for her diaper bag so I'm never without her creams. The small little flappy things are actually toothbrush covers.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the bottles easy to fill, squeeze, and clean.
Several reviewers report the bottles are leak proof and work well for travel.
The included bag is a common complaint, described as flimsy, broken, or ripping easily.
Some reviewers experienced leaking, especially with smaller bottles or jars.
Reviewers appreciate the silicone material and the extra items like toothbrush covers.
